method: One request for /robots.txt per host, parsed with Scout's own RobotsTxt class. A second request for /llms.txt only where the robots.txt we had just read permitted our own user-agent, plus a control request for a path that cannot exist, to catch handlers that answer 200 to anything. Self-identifying user-agent with a contact address, 8s timeout, no retries. No vendor crawler was impersonated.
reference_list: ai.robots.txt (https://github.com/ai-robots-txt/ai.robots.txt), 160 tokens, plus 7 vendor-documented tokens it is missing
